title: Eric Walker claimed Majestic 12 membership; Azadehdel conversation

tellings.quote: seemed to claim that he was part of the

plain: Eric A. Walker, a man connected to Penn State, is said to have claimed he belonged to Majestic 12, a group that some documents describe as a secret panel overseeing crashed UFOs. Michels says Walker "seemed to claim" this, and ties it to a conversation Walker had with a man named Henry Azadehdel, bringing in the work of the UFO researcher Grant Cameron. If true, it would be a rare admission from someone said to be inside such a group.
